Spectrum Agent Parity, OpenCode-Style Providers & Models, Settings Audit & macOS 27 Compliance

1Spectrum Agent Pricing & models.dev Resolution

autoPrices.ts · modelsDev.js · usage.ts
Root Cause Found: SpectrumAgentTab.tsx already passes withAutoPrices(api.settings.modelPrices, auto.prices) into spectrumStats(), but lookup fails for two reasons: (1) providers.js names DeepSeek’s direct model deepseek-flash while OpenRouter & models.dev index it as deepseek-v4.1-flash / deepseek-chat; (2) normalizeModelId() only replaces @ with -, so hyphen-vs-dot version IDs (e.g. Anthropic’s claude-opus-5-5 vs models.dev’s claude-opus-5.5) miss the cache completely. Finally, spectrumStats()’s fallback message never mentions models.dev.
Current (Reported Screenshot)
deepseek-flash fails exact key lookup in auto.prices and displays “Set a price for deepseek-flash in Settings › Models” even though pricing exists in models.dev.
Proposed (macOS 27 Liquid Glass + Auto-Price)

3Fixing Mid-Session Model Strength (Effort) Switching

LocalAgentTab.tsx · agentSessionService.js · transcript.ts · AgentHeader.tsx

Bug A — Local Agents ACP Sessions

In agentSessionService.js:1229, calling setAgentOption() sends session/set_config_option and runs emit(r, 'session', result). Many ACP adapters return {} without echoing configOptions, so transcript.ts:127 ignores the event and the UI snaps back to the old effort.

Fix: Patch r.configOptions in-place when the RPC succeeds without returning the array, emit a synthesized config_option_update event, and apply an optimistic update in LocalAgentTab.tsx with rollback on error.

Bug B — Spectrum Agent Threads

In AgentHeader.tsx:103, effortOptions() prepends ['default', 'Recommended (High)'] before ['none', 'low', 'high', 'max'], then strips Recommended (…) to High — creating two identical “High” stops. Dragging the range input also fires colliding un-debounced saveChat PUTs.

Fix: Deduplicate effort levels by showing a Recommended pill badge on the default level, commit on click with instant optimistic state + single debounced save, so the next turn or resumed run immediately applies the new strength.

5Modernizing Model Setup: OpenCode-Style Providers & Models Split

SettingsSheet.tsx · ProvidersPane.tsx · ModelsPane.tsx
Why the current Models page feels outdated: Right now Settings › Models mixes provider authentication (API keys, endpoints, test connection), model selection for 3 separate roles (Main / Quick / Vision), reasoning effort, and manual pricing into one long vertical form. Splitting it into two clean macOS 27 panes — Providers (connect once) and Models (search & toggle which models appear in your pickers + assign roles) — mirrors OpenCode’s crisp mental model while keeping Spectrum’s full power.
Current OpenPrism Settings › Models
Long vertical form repeating Provider / Endpoint / Key / Model dropdowns; hard to manage multiple providers or curate your model list.
OpenCode Reference (Providers + Models Split)
Clean separation: Providers manages connections & keys; Models provides search + collapsible provider accordions with per-model toggles.

Panel-by-Panel Settings UI Improvements

PanelCurrent UI Pain PointmacOS 27 Improvement
All Settings Panels Flat stacked fields separated only by spacing; hard to scan dense panes like Editor (8 sub-sections) and Engines. Wrap each logical section in a macOS 27 grouped inset card (12px radius, 1px hairline dividers between rows, right-aligned controls).
Providers & Models Single monolithic form; repeats API key & endpoint fields for Quick & Vision roles. Connected/Available Providers cards + searchable Models accordion with toggle switches & inline models.dev price/context pills.

7Review Tab Audit, Bug Fixes & Modular Panel Redesign

ReviewTab.tsx · preflight/run.ts · pdfFacts.ts · reviewService.js
Why the Review Tab Breaks & Feels Unusable: (1) Pressing Review unconditionally blocks behind a full api.compile(doc) whenever compileLog is empty or any file is newer—even for source/network checks like Privacy, References exist, or AI review—and aborts everything if compile is busy or fails; (2) reviewService.js:309 calls chatCompletion() without passing provider: llmConfig?.provider, causing provider-specific effort/API routing failures; (3) pdfFacts(...).catch(() => null) silently swallows PDF inspection errors; (4) ticks.ai checks modelReady() only once on mount and stays stuck off; (5) Seven bare checkboxes give zero explanation of what each check does and cannot be run independently.
Current Review Tab (Reported Screenshot)
7 unexplained checkboxes, an orphaned Anonymous review toggle floating in whitespace, and only a single monolithic Review button that wipes prior results and forces a compile.

Key Architectural Fixes

Decouple Compile from Non-PDF Checks: Only Compile & Layout and the PDF half of Submission Readiness need a fresh PDF. References, Verify Citations, Privacy, and AI Review run immediately on source/.bib files.

Pass provider in reviewService.js: Forward provider: llmConfig?.provider to chatCompletion() and reactively compute aiReady so AI Review works reliably with every configured provider.

Independent Per-Panel State: Store results per check key (results[checkId]) so running one panel never erases the findings of another, while Run all executes all enabled panels in parallel.

Audit of All 7 Review Functions — What They Do & Verdict

FunctionWhat It Actually ChecksVerdict & Action
Compile & layout TeX errors, overfull hbox/vbox (margin overflows), unresolved ??, missing font glyphs, duplicate link targets, mixed page sizes (A4 vs Letter), text overflowing page edges. Keep & Fix
Surface pdfFacts errors instead of swallowing; allow running against existing PDF/log.
References & assets Undefined \cite/\ref, duplicate labels & duplicate .bib works (DOI/arXiv/title), missing required BibTeX fields, malformed DOIs, unused entries, missing images, unreferenced figures/tables. Keep & Enhance
No compile needed. Add Typst @ref/#image support instead of showing a dead notice.
References exist
(Rename: Verify citations)		 Queries Crossref, doi.org, arXiv & OpenAlex to confirm every .bib entry is real, diffs title/authors/year/venue side-by-side, and flags retracted papers. Keep & Promote
High-value anti-hallucination check! Decouple from compile and give it its own Run button.
Privacy & blind review Scans up to 400 files for leaked secrets (.env, private keys, API tokens), leftover TODO/\todo/\hl; with Anonymous on: flags \author, affiliations, emails, ORCID, acknowledgements & PDF Author metadata. Keep & Clean up
Nest the Anonymous / double-blind switch cleanly inside its card; no compile required.
Submission readiness PDF version (>1.7), encryption, unembedded & Type 3 bitmap fonts (IEEE rejects), absolute paths, case-sensitive path mismatches (arXiv), unsupported pdfLaTeX images (.svg/.webp), spaces in filenames, missing abstract/keywords. Keep & Streamline
Split source checks (instant) from PDF font/version checks (when PDF exists). Fold useful PDF checks (bookmarks, <6pt text, skipped headings) in here.
Accessibility PDF/UA Tagged mark, PDF Title/Language, alt= on every \includegraphics, <6pt text, bookmarks, blank pages, skipped heading levels, vague link text + Screen reader view. Remove from Default / Optional
Standard LaTeX templates fail PDF/UA tagging & alt= on every figure, producing 15–30 unfixable warnings. Move bookmarks/<6pt/headings into Submission; delete noisy PDF/UA checks (or hide behind an optional toggle).
AI review Chunked read-only referee pass checking Terminology, Notation, Data contradictions, Logic, Style, Citation needed, Missing experiments; returns line-anchored Major/Minor/Note points + score/10. Keep & Fix
Pass provider to chatCompletion(), decouple from compile, and run asynchronously in its own panel so it never blocks fast local checks.

9Diagram Composer Audit & Structural Bent / Parabolic Beam Member

structures/model.ts · draw.ts · code.ts · panels.tsx · ComposerApp.tsx
Current Diagram Chooser (Reported Screenshot)
Spectrum category dots and tinted TikZ pills look great, but starter cards are text-only (no line-art previews), the window lacks macOS 27 Liquid Glass sidebar styling, and the bottom filename bar feels disconnected.

Diagram Composer UI Improvements

1. Line-Art Card Previews: Add crisp monochrome/area-tinted SVG thumbnails (beam, circuit, flowchart, axes, commutative grid) inside each starter card for instant visual recognition.

2. macOS 27 Shell Parity: Apply the same translucent sidebar styling, concentric 14px card radii, and 3-tier control heights (24 / 28 / 34px) used in the main editor window.

3. Plot Mode absorbs Table → Chart: Add an Import table from document / CSV button directly inside Plot mode so all charting lives in Diagram Composer.

4. Structural Analysis — Bent Beam Member: Add a first-class bend property on Member + a draggable midpoint deflection handle on canvas + native TikZ Bézier export.

Exact Implementation Spec for Bent Beam Members

        

          
FileChange

          
            

              diagram/modes/structures/model.ts
              Add bend?: { sag: number; shape?: 'parabola' | 'cubic' | 'arc'; ghost?: boolean } to Member. Update placeAt() to evaluate point loads along the quadratic/cubic curve so mid-span forces sit directly on the bent beam.

              diagram/modes/structures/panels.tsx & Canvas.tsx

11App-Wide UI Audit & macOS 27 Liquid Glass Standards

        glass.css · base.css · editor.css · tools.css · projects.css
      


      

        
      


      

        

          
1. Missing Liquid Glass Surfaces

          
glass.css:34 omits .tuning-pop, .stat-pop, .palette, .agent-slash, and .composer.

          
Fix: Add all 5 selectors + specular top rim + @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) solid fallback.

        

        

          
2. Control Height Standardization

          
9 ad-hoc control heights (22–40px) exist across base.css, editor.css, and tools.css.

          
Fix: Consolidate to 3 tokens: --ctrl-sm: 24px, --ctrl-md: 28px, --ctrl-lg: 34px.

        

        

          
3. Concentric Corner Radii

          
Standardize all floating popovers and menus to 14px outer radius, 6px padding, and 8px item radius.

        

        

          
4. Sidebar Collapse Header Jump

          
base.css:455–468 jumps .panel-header between 64px and 52px on collapse.

          
Fix: Unify at 52px to match the macOS traffic-light titlebar.

        

        

          
5. Floating vs Agent Composer

          
Unify the bottom floating Assistant card (.composer) and .agent-composer around the same 2-row action bar, 28px Send button, and cascading model/effort pill.

        

        

          
6. Agent Bar De-cluttering

          
Replace the static Isolated badge in SpectrumAgentTab.tsx with a quiet tooltipped lock icon so both tabs have matching visual weight.
